paragraphs: The primary objectives of this project are to develop a low-cost, real-time soil moisture monitoring system using the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller. The system will include an ADC for analog soil moisture voltage measurement, GPIO for status alerts, and UART for serial communication with a USB-to-UART adapter.
bullets: To achieve this, we will configure the ADC to read from the Soil Moisture Sensor Analog Out pin (PA0). The ADC will convert the analog signal into a digital value that can be processed by the microcontroller.
We will also configure GPIOC for the Onboard Status LED (PC13), which will turn on when an action is needed. This will provide visual feedback to the user about the system's status.
Finally, we will configure USART1 for serial communication with a USB-to-UART adapter. The system will use UART to send and receive data over a serial connection at 115200 baud.
